title: WriteSharedFileInput
description: Upload one file from your working directory to the project's shared files (store data, samples, exports other sessions or users need; not deliverables, use publish_file for those). Shared files belong to the project: every session (coordinator, leads, members of all threads) and every user of the project can see, overwrite and delete them; they are stored by the platform, never in git. Do not put secrets (keys, passwords, tokens, credentials) in shared files. A file with the same path is overwritten. Limits: 200 MB per file, 5 GB per project.

file.description: A single file inside your working directory, relative to it (directories are refused).

path.description: Target path in the shared files. Default: file normalised to a relative path, with a leading .shared/ removed (so a file fetched with read_shared_file goes back to the same path).

overwritten.description: True when a file with this path existed and was replaced.
